data.one_liner: Horizontal card pager widget for Flutter with image or icon‑title cards.
data.what_it_does: Provides a horizontally scrolling pager of cards that can display either images or an icon with a title. The widget offers callbacks for page changes and item selection and works on mobile, web, and desktop platforms.
use_when: You need a simple horizontal carousel of custom cards
You want built‑in support for both image‑only and icon‑title card layouts
You require a widget that works on web as well as mobile
avoid_when: You need vertical paging (use the separate Vertical Card Pager)
You require extensive animation or indicator customization beyond the provided API
You need a highly configurable carousel with many layout options
strengths: Easy to integrate with minimal code
Supports both image and icon‑title card types
